results.summary_before: This design is an 8-bit binary counter driven by an internal 1 Hz clock and a chain of D flip-flops, with each output intended to light an LED to show the binary count. It is tested simply by powering the chip and connecting up to eight LEDs, with resistors recommended to limit current. The documentation notes that the flip-flops may power up in an unknown state because the author could not implement a reset, so the LEDs may already be lit at boot. No external hardware beyond the LEDs is required, and the project is a straightforward Wokwi counter with a known reset limitation.
